 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Charlotte Hornets are at home Saturday night as they host the Miami Heat in an Eastern Conference matchup.
 Charlotte enters Saturday's game with a 1-1 record after losing at home to the Atlanta Hawks Friday night.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Charlotte Hornets center Naz Reid (0)Scott Kinser-Imagn Images
 In Friday's loss, Naz Reid led the way for the Hornets as he recorded 17 points and six rebounds while Tidjane Salaun added 11 points and five rebounds of his own off the bench.
 The Hornets will try to bounce back Saturday as they face off against the Heat in a tough home matchup.
 Miami enters Saturday's contest with an 0-2 record after losing at home to the Detroit Pistons Friday night.
 Miami Heat forward Giannis Antetokounmpo (7)Jim Rassol-Imagn Images
 Giannis Antetokounmpo led the way for the Heat in Friday's loss as he ended the game with 36 points, 12 rebounds and five assists while Davion Mitchell recorded 18 points and five assists.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement While both teams are looking to pick up a victory in Saturday night's matchup, one may be without multiple key players due to injuries.
 Heat Injury Report: Will Pelle Larsson Play?
 The Heat have only one player listed on their injury report as they have listed Pelle Larsson as probable and he is expected to play despite dealing with a left finger sprain.
 Hornets Injury Report: Will Kon Knueppel, Coby White Play?
 Charlotte Hornets guard Kon Knueppel (7)Scott Kinser - Imagn Images
 The Hornets have five players listed on their injury report, including Kon Knueppel and Coby White.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Charlotte has ruled out Knueppel as he will miss his third consecutive contest due to a left hamstring strain.
 The Hornets have also ruled out White due to a left calf strain as he will miss his third straight game as well.
 With both Knueppel and White sidelined, Dennis Schroder and Grayson Allen could continue to have increased roles.
 Charlotte Hornets guard Coby White (3)Scott Kinser-Imagn Images
 The Hornets have also ruled out Grant Williams due to a right hamstring strain while Kylan Boswell is out as he continues to recover from right knee surgery.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Christian Anderson has been listed as probable and he is expected to play despite dealing with a left ankle sprain.
 Fans can catch Saturday night's matchup between the Heat and Hornets from the Spectrum Center at 6 p.m. ET.
